title: Development: milestones, autism, ADHD and intellectual disability

steps.tx: **Neurodevelopment** means how a child gains motor, language and social skills in order over 5 years. Smile at 6 weeks, sit at 6 months and walk at 12 months in 95 percent. **Milestones** from 3 domains guide screening of 100 toddlers at 9 months. Delay beyond 2 standard steps needs assessment within 2 weeks in 20 percent of cases.

steps.tx: **Fragile X** with 200 repeats and **Down syndrome** trisomy 21 drive 10 percent of delays in 500 children. **Rett syndrome** follows 1 mutation with loss after 12 months in girls. Maternal 3 infections, alcohol in 2 percent and 4 weeks of prematurity raise risk. **Folate** 0.4 mg daily cuts neural tube defects by 70 percent in 1000 pregnancies.

steps.tx: **Autism spectrum** alters synapses with 1 percent prevalence in 1000 children and 4 to 1 male excess. Genes plus prenatal 3 exposures shape 2 main brain circuits early. **Oxytocin** and 2 brain areas control eye contact by 6 months. **Chromosomal microarray** finds 15 percent diagnoses in 3 month testing for 2 year olds.

steps.tx: DSM-5 requires **social communication** deficits plus 2 restricted patterns from 4 listed behaviours. Onset before 3 years with functional harm in 70 percent of cases. A 30 month boy shows 5 echolalia repeats and 1 hand flap routine daily. **MCHAT** at 18 months flags 2 of 20 items for referral in 80 percent sensitivity.

steps.tx: **Bayley scales** at 24 months give motor and language scores for 100 referrals yearly. **IQ** below 70 defines intellectual disability with onset before 18 years. **Vineland** adaptive score below 70 plus 2 domain lows confirm cases in 4 weeks. Check hearing in 2 ears and vision in 1 visit because 8 percent of delays hide these faults.

steps.tx: **Methylphenidate** 10 mg twice daily helps 70 percent of 7 year old ADHD cases by 4 weeks. **Atomoxetine** 40 mg daily suits boys with 2 tics and anxiety. **ADHD** needs 6 symptoms for 6 months in 2 settings for 50 percent of 8 year olds. Start 1 drug at 2.5 mg test dose then raise by 2.5 mg weekly to 30 mg.

steps.tx: **ABA** therapy gives 10 hours weekly for 12 months in 60 percent of autism toddlers. **Intellectual disability** needs 1 learning plan with 3 goals per 6 months for 4 year olds. **Speech** 30 minutes twice weekly lifts 2 word use in 50 percent by 1 year. **Risperidone** 0.25 mg curbs severe 5 times daily self injury in 30 percent.
